about: Camera placement check (TV-CAL-03, TV-CAL-04). Lens angles are GoPro's published MISSION 1 / MISSION 1 PRO digital-lens field of view, HyperSmooth off, from GoPro's support article 'MISSION 1 AND MISSION 1 PRO: Digital Lenses FOV Information'. PROVISIONAL until a camera's lens is calibrated (TV-CAL-01). Frame sizes for 4:3 are assumed (3840 x 2880).
superView: SuperView 16:9 is 128 x 99 x 156 deg: the 4:3 Wide picture stretched sideways to 16:9. Not used (spec: never SuperView).
